## Objectives

- Defeat 40 [Snapping Lizard](../monsters/snapping_lizard.md) in [The Young Woods](../maps/young_woods.md)

## Rewards

- 2,550 EXP
- 360 mesos
- [Orange Potion](../items/orange_potion.md) x10
- +20 standing with Midbarium
- +30 standing with [Corwell](../npcs/corwell.md)
